verdict.rationale: Superhuman's main programmatic surface is an official Mail MCP server. Through it, AI assistants can summarize threads, draft and send email, schedule meetings, and use Superhuman-specific features like Split Inbox triage, sent tracking, Read Statuses, Smart Send and Ask AI. That is a real but bounded subset of the UI: there is no published general API (OpenAPI/llms.txt probes 404), sends require explicit approval, and nothing claims full UI parity. Missing for 10: a documented public API or OpenAPI spec, a stated parity guarantee, programmatic coverage of settings, Auto Label and split configuration, Snippets, team comments and calendar configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
You can also do things that are uniquely Superhuman: triage by Split Inbox, track sent emails, check Read Statuses, Smart Send, and Ask AI.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.
